caseName: Ardell Lee, Etc. v. United States

attorneys: Lee S. Kreindler and Samuel N. Hecsh for petitioners., Solicitor General Griswold, Assistant Attorney General Weisl, Morton Hollander, and Leonard Schaitman for the United States.

opinions.text:
C. A. 9th Cir. Certiorari denied.

Mr. Justice Douglas is of the opinion that certiorari should be granted. Mr. Justice Marshall took no part in the consideration or decision of this petition.
